items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: He asked me to do it, and I made a test record for him of 'I Travel Alone'.

ctx.x: Prince of Wales at that time. And they used to come in, and I used to sing different songs, and I guess he just thought my voice was all right and asked me to do 'Two Cigarettes in the Dark,' which I did. And what else did I do? Oh, 'Miss Otis Regrets'. I did 'Miss Otis', and 'I Travel Alone' -- very smart song. You -- this is one of the smartest songs you ever heard.

He asked me to do it, and I made a test record for him of 'I Travel Alone'. I used to sing it down to the Bon Soir when I was here, but it was a -- it's a smart song. I've never heard anybody do it -- very smart. That was his. So that's how I happened to do those songs. I introduced them.
That 'Two Cigarettes in the Dark,' that's a beautiful thing. That's what I told him --
